'''Flaming Chestplate''' is a {{Rare}} [[Chestplate]], which is obtainable as a drop from the [[Lava Flame]] [[Sea Creature]]. It reduces damage from {{MobType|Magmatic}} mobs by {{Green|5%}}, and increase damage against them by {{Red|1.1x}}.

*It has the same effect as the [[Moogma Leggings]] and [[Taurus Helmet]], and it is part of the secret [[Lava Sea Creature Armor]] set, which consists of the aforementioned armor pieces plus [[Slug Boots]].
